We need to find mapped_rxn and template_id that when applied to the given molecule (target) reproduces the reaction described (Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons). We have precursors from previous step: three SMILES strings (possible precursors). Those are likely the product of applying template? Actually make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1 asked to return all possible precursors of applying the template as result of make_5_lvl2-template_search-1 to the molecule below. So we have a target molecule (the one given in that previous step). The answer gave three precursor SMILES (list of lists). So we need to find which template produced those precursors. So we need to search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_broken: carbon-phosphorus bond and carbon-oxygen bond broken; functional_groups_formed: aliphatic carboxylic acid and C-C double bond; bonds formed: C=C (double bond) maybe; bonds broken: C-P, C-O. Also overall reaction is Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons (HWE). So we need to search template catalog. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with target molecule? The target molecule is the product of HWE: an alkene with E-selectivity attached to a carboxylic acid? The precursors include a phosphonate group? Let's inspect one precursor SMILES: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO". This looks like a phosphonate? Actually contains O[Si] etc. Not obvious. The other: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C". The third: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO". These seem to be the product? Actually they have a C=C double bond attached to a sugar-like ring? Hard.

But we just need to return mapped_rxn and template_id. Likely there is a known template ID for HWE. Could search. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_broken = ["C-P","C-O"] etc. Let's try.
